Short title and commencement

ACT XXIV OF 1992
ACT XXIV OF 1992
SENATE (ELECTION)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th December, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the-assent of the President on the 9th
December, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the Senate (Election)
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13, Act LI of 1975

ACT XXIV OF 1992
ACT XXIV OF 1992
SENATE (ELECTION)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th December, 1992]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the-assent of the President on the 9th
December, 1992, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 13,
Act LI of 1975.--In the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), in
section 13, in subsection (5), after the words "on such appeal", the
commas and words", after affording to the persons referred to in
subsection (1) an opportunity of being heard," shall be inserted.
